svg.data-waive-silhouette-missing: a paperclip is a single bent wire with no body to tint
svg.data-waive-off-grid: the clip lies at 45 degrees, so its strand ends follow the rotated loops, not the 0.25 grid
svg.data-waive-radius: the bends are the wire's loops, sized by the 3.5 strand spacing, not rounded corners
